bodyReadWithoutStatusCheck.text: This reads the body of a fetch Response on a path where neither `.ok` nor `.status` is read. fetch does not throw on an HTTP error, so a 401 or 500 body is parsed here and used as data (an error object returned as a task list, a failure cached as a success). Check `response.ok` before trusting the body, and throw or return the failure when it is false.

responseDiscarded.text: This awaits a fetch Response and drops it. fetch does not throw on an HTTP error, so a request that fails with a 400 or 500 runs on as if it succeeded. Keep the Response and check `response.ok`, and throw or return the failure when it is false.
